BiblicalUsage: Malak is the Aramaic word for an angel, a messenger, and both of its appearances are rescues. Daniel 3:28 has Nebuchadnezzar blessing the God who sent His angel to deliver Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego from the furnace, and Daniel 6:22 has Daniel saying, my God hath sent His angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the angel in both verses is the same promise: God sends His messenger when His people cannot save themselves.
